messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] cont-batching-service latency spike + kv-cache eviction surge detected on prod-west-2. 95th latency > 2s for generation routes. Auto-escalation triggered. (alert_id: cb-evict-3421)
Oncall_Bob: ack. I'm on it. Pulling up dashboards and logs.
SRE_Jane: seeing KV cache eviction rate x12 baseline, mem pressure on mgt-pool-3. Also a huge number of batches hitting max_batch_tokens causing partial-batches to stall.
Eng_Matt: thanks. hypothesis: recent rollout changed default max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 8192 in cont-batch config, combined with spikier seqs caused huge batch accumulation + paging.
Infra_Ravi: confirmed hosts show paging io at 90% for gpu-nodes in west-2a. OOMs not yet but swap thrash happening.
Support_Lee: fielding customer reports: several customers seeing timeouts for long-turn chat sessions (~10-20% for affected routes). High-priority accounts notified.
Product_Anya: which routes are impacted? chat-streaming and long-completion endpoints only?
SRE_Jane: primarily /v1/chat/stream and /v1/generate when seq_len > 2k. Short queries unaffected.
Oncall_Bob: can we throttle by reducing max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs on the runtime? Prefer a quick config rollback to last known-good.
Eng_Matt: I can push a hotfix to the cont-batch config. Plan: set max_batch_tokens=2048, max_num_seqs=8, reduce collect_timeout_ms from 50 -> 20 temporarily. Also enable kv-cache eviction-throttle to 0.6.
Ops_Alex: rolling config to canary nodes now (canary group c-2: 6 nodes). Will monitor.
SRE_Jane: adding a temporary fallback policy: route long sessions to model-variant small-kv (less caching) to avoid eviction storms.
DevEx_Nora: posting a short customer-facing blurb to status page drafts. Need ETA estimate for mitigation.
Support_Lee: customers want ETA. Can we get initial mitigation within 10m?
Eng_Matt: canary config applied at 2423456890.
IncidentBot: Deploy job cb-config-hotfix started by Eng_Matt (job: cbcfg-559):
```
apply config cont-batch --env prod --group c-2 --set max_batch_tokens=2048 max_num_seqs=8 collect_timeout_ms=20 kv_eviction_throttle=0.6
```
SRE_Jane: canary metrics showing 40% drop in eviction rate already. 95th latency down from 2.1s -> 1.1s on canary.
Oncall_Bob: roll to 50% of nodes. Ops_Alex proceeding.
Infra_Ravi: watch disk IO – after config change paging dropped 35% on canary nodes. No new OOMs.
Eng_Matt: rolling to full cluster at 2423456945.
IncidentBot: Deploy job cb-config-hotfix completed successfully (cbcfg-559) at 2423456950.
SRE_Jane: global metrics now trending back to baseline. Error rate on long sessions reduced from 12% -> 1.8%.
Support_Lee: updating customers: initial mitigation deployed, continuing to monitor. ETA for full verification 30m.
Product_Anya: quick note — this change reduces throughput for very large batches; could increase unit cost slightly. We'll track impact.
Ops_Alex: enabling temporary rate-limiter on long-session route to cap max concurrent long-seqs at 500 requests to avoid reappearing storms.
Eng_Matt: adding a patch to revert default config to 2048 in runtime defaults and adding a config guard to block >4096 without an opt-in. Will open PR.
DevEx_Nora: status update posted to status.redwood: "Mitigation deployed, customers on long sessions may see reduced latency. Investigating root cause and follow-ups."
SRE_Jane: root cause notes: combination of increased max_batch_tokens + sudden shift in customer workload with many long sequences causing expensive KV cache population and paging. Also collect_timeout_ms too high allowed batches to wait and accumulate.
Oncall_Bob: handing off to SRE_Jane for blameless postmortem. I'll escalate to Eng_Matt & Infra_Ravi for follow-up action items.
SRE_Jane: will run forensic logs and correlate with config rollout (cbcfg-551 -> cbcfg-559) and the deployment timeline.
Eng_Matt: created PR #7482 to add config guard + e2e test against high-seq workloads.
Infra_Ravi: creating infra alert to trigger when kv-eviction-rate > 3x baseline AND paging_io > 70% so we catch this earlier.
Support_Lee: consolidated customer list for outreach: 7 affected tenants flagged as P1 scope.
Product_Anya: schedule a cross-team postmortem doc. Would like recommended guardrails and a change in rollout cadence for cont-batch config.
SRE_Jane: follow-ups: 1) revert default and add guard, 2) add alert rule (Infra_Ravi), 3) add load-e2e in CI (Eng_Matt), 4) customer comms wrap-up (Support_Lee).
Oncall_Bob: thx all — I'm clear. SRE_Jane you lead the postmortem. If anything spikes ping me. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident cb-evict-3421 marked as mitigated at 2423457045.
DevEx_Nora: saving thread notes to /runbooks/incidents/contbatch-kv-2024-2423456789 and will draft postmortem template.
Support_Lee: will keep watch and reopen if regression occurs.
Eng_Matt: postmortem draft incoming. Adding logs, perf graphs, and the minimal repro script.
SRE_Jane: thanks everyone. Closing incident channel once postmortem lives.
